name: x48-usage
description: Saves Claude Code's 5-hour and weekly limits, context fill and session cost for the 48X AI Usage app.

dataDir.title: 48X AI Usage data folder (optional)
dataDir.description: Leave empty to use the app's own folder. Set it only when the 48X AI Usage app keeps its data somewhere else: an absolute path, whose sessions folder is the only place the mod writes.
